title: Burgess Key Event Credential v1
description: A signed key-lifecycle event for a did:key (Ed25519) controller: birth, rotation, revocation, or recovery. Events form an append-only hash chain (each references the previous log head). Public ledgers and Bitcoin anchors carry only the sha256 commitment to the key-event log head; private keys and seeds never appear here.

did.description: The controller did:key asserted by this event.

prev.description: Commitment of the previous key-event log head. null only for the first KeyBirth event.

supersedesDid.description: For KeyRotation: the DID being succeeded. The superseded key signs the rotation event.

reason.description: Closed-vocabulary reason for KeyRevocation or KeyRecovery.

commitment.description: SHA-256 over the canonical sorted-key JSON of this event (excluding commitment and signature).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature, by the key authoritative at event time, over the DID signing payload built from the commitment.

anchor.description: Optional proof-of-existence references for this event or the resulting log head.
